message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: "Check iOS Compile"

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [dev]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ios-compile-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  compile-ios:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'
      - uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
        with:
          packages: 'platform-tools'
          log-accepted-android-sdk-licenses: false
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v5
      - name: Inspect build environment
        run: |
          java -version
          xcodebuild -version
          uname -m
          chmod +x gradlew
      - name: Prepare resources and Apple version
        run: ./gradlew composeApp:exportLibraryDefinitions composeApp:updateAppleBuildVersion --console=plain
      # 覆盖真机 Kotlin/Native 优化链接，不归档、不签名、不上传。
      - name: Link iOS arm64 Release framework
        run: ./gradlew composeApp:linkReleaseFrameworkIosArm64 --console=plain
      # 通过现有 Xcode Build Phase 编译模拟器 framework，并验证 Swift 宿主集成。
      - name: Build simulator app without signing
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          mkdir -p build/reports/ios
          xcodebuild \
            -project iosApp/iosApp.xcodeproj \
            -scheme iosApp \
            -configuration Debug \
            -sdk iphonesimulator \
            -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' \
            -derivedDataPath build/ios-derived-data \
            -resultBundlePath build/reports/ios/SimulatorBuild.xcresult \
            ARCHS=arm64 ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=YES \
            CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO \
            CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY= DEVELOPMENT_TEAM= PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER= \
            build 2>&1 | tee build/reports/ios/xcodebuild.log
      - name: Upload iOS diagnostics
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ios-compile-diagnostics
          path: |
            build/reports/ios/
            build/reports/problems/
          if-no-files-found: warn
",
  "rationale": "The workflow's single job currently has a 60-minute timeout, but historical successful runs (3 runs) complete in approximately 29 minutes. Applying a tighter custom timeout of 45 minutes reduces the risk of runaway consumption while preserving ample headroom (16 minutes, ~55% buffer) for variability such as cold cache or runner load. This aligns with pattern P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT, which reports custom timeouts reduce runaway consumption (vm_time_reduction_percent: free 12.9%, paid 8.1%) and is supported by experimental evidence showing a 26.8% elapsed savings when adding a timeout to a job without one. The change is minimal, preserves all build and test coverage, and does not weaken permissions or add privileged actions.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
